sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF is a 9-billion parameter dense language model built for code generation and agentic reasoning, maintained by ornith-ai. This is a quantized GGUF variant of the full-precision model, enabling deployment on consumer hardware while maintaining the reasoning capabilities of the original. sources.title: Ornith 1.5 9B: Local Test Results Expose a Benchmark Gap
sources.snippet: What is Ornith 1.5 9B and does it live up to its benchmarks? Ornith 1.5 9B is a dense, 9-billion-parameter language model built by ornith-ai, designed to run on a single GPU or even mobile hardware in quantized GGUF format.
